text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by the outdoor stage――

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Like... a swan...!!
Strong...!! And beautiful...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Whew. Was that footwork
a bit too dazzling for you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There are no spectators yet, but the thought that a massive crowd
will one day scream my name in wild fervor—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're...urk?!
Could it be that you were watching my performance?!
choice_data_list: No, I was just passing by and――

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I get it, I totally get it!
You were utterly captivated in an instant, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The victory pose revealed after a win...! Witnessing that, it's only natural to react that way!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it?
Did my performance do justice to the lingering thrill of the race?
choice_data_list: Maybe doing a normal victory lap would be better...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it?
Did my performance do justice to the lingering thrill of the race?
choice_data_list: Maybe doing a normal victory lap would be better...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A winning run...? Oho,
the magnificent sight of I, the victor, galloping alone...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I see... That sounds splendid too!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You wish to showcase the supreme, majestic beauty of the Overlord,
etching it deep into everyone's memories, yes?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that that's settled, let's try it right away!
Commencing our winning run etude!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, TM Opera O departed,
waving her hand to an imaginary audience.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
Isn't that right? Of course it is!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Striking a gorgeous pose upon the turf is the true mark of the Supreme Ruler!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: All right, let's make it even wilder next time! Come, join in the grand crescendo of fervor!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I ended up watching TM Opera O
continue practicing her dramatic poses.
